$comment: P4 prop prompts for scripts/lookdev/leonardo.mjs (gen --prop <id> --variant <x>). Each is a TRELLIS.2 input sheet: one object, whole, plain grey ground. The style block's palette and finish are restated by the script; the scene framing (first person, depth of field, site plan) is not used.
sheet: a single object only, shown whole and uncropped and centred in frame, orthographic front three-quarter view, on a plain flat neutral mid-grey background, even soft diffuse light, no cast shadow clutter, no floor line, no props or hands or people, no text, no labels, no logos, no markings, clean readable silhouette.

lamp-agent.name: the lamp agent, a calm architect's drafting lamp (not a robot, not a creature, no face, no claws, no legs)
lamp-agent.materials: matte dark powder-coated metal in near-black blue, brushed pale metal joints, a warm amber emissive lamp head glowing softly, warm paper-coloured inner shade

variants.A: Classic spring-balanced drafting lamp: a two-joint arm of two slim tubes with visible coil springs, a conical metal shade with a warm amber glowing opening, and a weighted round base that clamps onto a table edge.
variants.B: Parallel-link pantograph drafting lamp: a two-joint arm made of parallel pairs of thin rods, a flat round disc head that glows warm amber on its underside, and a low clamp base that grips a table edge.
variants.C: Slim tube drafting lamp: a two-joint arm of thin round tubes with one prominent hinge knuckle at the elbow, a smooth domed head glowing warm amber, and a small edge clamp base.
variants.D: Counterweighted drafting lamp: a two-joint arm with a small cylindrical counterweight at the back of the upper link, a rectangular box shade glowing warm amber on its underside, and a flat clamp base.

studio-shelves.name: a dark studio wall shelf unit with three shelves, holding a few plain books and rolled drawings
studio-shelves.materials: near-black blue painted wood, thin brushed metal brackets, warm paper-coloured book spines and rolls without any lettering

variants.A: A tall narrow open shelf unit with three shelves on two slim side frames, a few unlabelled books and two rolled drawings resting on the shelves.
variants.B: A wide open shelf unit with three shelves on two slim side frames, a few unlabelled books leaning on the shelves and one rolled drawing.

studio-desk-lamp.name: a small studio desk lamp with a warm glowing shade, an ordinary quiet lamp for the room set dressing
studio-desk-lamp.materials: matte near-black blue metal, brushed pale metal hinge, warm amber glowing shade interior, warm paper-coloured glow

variants.A: A simple desk lamp with a round weighted base, one slim stem, and a conical shade with a warm amber glowing opening.
variants.B: A simple desk lamp with a rectangular weighted base, a short two-joint arm, and a rounded shade with a warm amber glowing opening.

studio-mug.name: a plain ceramic coffee mug
studio-mug.materials: matte ceramic in warm paper colour with a cyan-white inner glaze, near-black blue handle edge, no print

variants.A: A plain straight-sided mug with a simple loop handle, empty, with no pattern and no print.
variants.B: A plain slightly tapered mug with a thick loop handle, empty, with no pattern and no print.

studio-drawing-tubes.name: a small bundle of drawing tubes and rolled drawings standing in a holder
studio-drawing-tubes.materials: matte near-black blue cardboard tubes with pale metal end caps, warm paper-coloured rolled drawings, thin cyan-white edge highlights

variants.A: Four cylindrical drawing tubes of different heights standing upright together, two with end caps on and one rolled drawing sticking out of the top.
variants.B: Five cylindrical drawing tubes of different heights leaning together in a round holder, caps on, with two rolled drawings poking out of the top.

studio-pinned-drawings.name: a flat set of three framed drawing sheets hung together on a wall panel, shown flat and front-on
studio-pinned-drawings.materials: warm paper sheets with fine cyan-white linework on blueprint blue, thin near-black blue frames, small amber pins

variants.A: Three flat rectangular drawing sheets of different sizes in thin frames, arranged together, each with abstract architectural linework and no readable text, held by small amber pins.
variants.B: Three flat rectangular drawing sheets of the same size in a row, in thin frames, each with abstract architectural linework and no readable text, held by small amber pins.
